items.title: OpenAI reports big gains on COBOL, Fortran and other low-resource languages

items.title: Directive 8020 free update adds online multiplayer for up to five players
items.summary: Supermassive 喺 10 月 19 日為《Directive 8020: A Dark Pictures Game》推出免費更新，加入最多五人網上合作（每人需自備遊戲），含 Custom／Round Robin 模式同 Choice Voting，並加新太空衣自訂同 13 個 Premonition 收集品；支援 PS5、Xbox Series 同 PC，暫無跨平台。
items.imageAlt: Directive 8020 online multiplayer update screenshot from Gematsu

items.title: Zenless Zone Zero European PS5 age rating rises from PEGI 12 to 16
items.summary: Push Square 報道《Zenless Zone Zero》歐洲 PS5 版年齡分級由 PEGI 12 升至 PEGI 16，說明含中度暴力同性暗示；美國仍為 Teen、App Store 仍約 13+。官方未詳細解釋原因，或同近期 PEGI 對已發售含付費隨機道具遊戲調級有關。
items.note: Rating change confirmed on European PS5 storefront reporting; causal link to PEGI loot-box policy vs content descriptors not officially confirmed.
items.imageAlt: Zenless Zone Zero artwork from Push Square age-rating story

items.title: Saros Zenith free update adds Overlord Rush, New Game+, and accessibility options
items.summary: Housemarque 喺 10 月 19 日為 PS5 獨佔《Saros》推出免費 Zenith 更新，加入 Overlord Rush 首領挑戰、Eclipse Layers（New Game+）、大量難度修飾器，以及慢速遊戲、自動開火同動態感應瞄準等無障礙選項。
items.note: Also covered by Gematsu Oct 19 with matching feature list.
items.imageAlt: Saros Zenith update key art from PlayStation Blog

items.title: Microsoft emails some Xbox owners about Best Buy trade-ins up to $375
items.summary: 有 Xbox 玩家收到 Microsoft 針對性電郵，鼓勵透過 Best Buy 回收閒置主機，Series X 最高約 $375、Series S 約 $200（視型號同成色）；屬 6 月加價後「令 Xbox 更易入手」計劃一部分，同融資同翻新機並行。
items.note: Based on user-shared emails and reporting; exact eligibility and payouts vary by condition. publishedAt approximate (article day Oct 19).
items.imageAlt: Xbox hardware imagery accompanying trade-in program coverage

items.title: DuneCrawl launches on PS5, Xbox Series, and Android October 19
items.summary: Alientrap 喺 10 月 19 日宣布合作開放世界動作冒險《DuneCrawl》已登陸 PS5、Xbox Series 同 Android；PC 早前已發售，Switch／Switch 2 則排本年稍後。遊戲支援最多四人本地或網上合作，以巨型蟹形 Dune Crawler 探索沙海。
items.note: Alientrap post og:image is site logo only; Gematsu Oct 5 dated the console window. publishedAt approximate (post day, no exact time).

items.title: UKIE and Sheridans launch AI Compliance and Accreditation Service for UK studios
items.summary: 英國遊戲協會 UKIE 聯同律師行 Sheridans 推出 AI 合規認證服務：問卷、風險評估、度身政策撰寫／審閱後可獲 UKIE AI Certification Mark，供融資同合作盡職調查展示；會員全套約 £1,500–£2,000（未連 VAT）。
items.note: Primary programme page: https://ukie.org.uk/ai-certification-mark — article og:image is AI-generated illustrative, so imageUrl left null.

items.title: Liquid Swords CEO confirms studio closure; Samson sold better on consoles
items.summary: 繼破產報道後，Liquid Swords 負責人 Christofer Sundberg 喺 10 月 19 日確認工作室關閉，指《Samson》主機銷售遠勝 PC 但仍不足以救公司；正討論繼續支援該作。屬對早前破產新聞嘅官方確認更新。
items.note: Genuine update to Oct 18 Liquid Swords bankruptcy coverage; CEO confirmation + console sales comment is new.
items.imageAlt: Samson gameplay still from Push Square closure update

items.title: Report: Disney/Lucasfilm talking to studios including DICE and Bungie about Battlefront 3
items.summary: Insider Gaming 引述 Electronic Games Monthly／Jeff Grubb 相關傳聞，指 Disney／Lucasfilm 正接觸多家工作室探討新作《Star Wars Battlefront》，傳聞名單包括 EA DICE 同 Bungie；各方未評論，報道強調若屬實仍屬極早期洽談。
items.note: Unconfirmed rumor via EGM/Grubb chain; no studio or Disney confirmation.
items.imageAlt: Star Wars Battlefront 2 imagery used in Battlefront 3 rumor coverage

items.title: Supercell completes full acquisition of Merge Mansion maker Metacore
items.summary: PocketGamer.biz 報道 Supercell 喺 10 月 19 日完成全面收購芬蘭工作室 Metacore，取得 100% 股權；《Merge Mansion》團隊正式加入 Supercell 繼續營運該作，交易金額未披露，原預期 9 月底完成。
items.note: Completion confirmed Oct 19; earlier May announcement and Aug signing posts are older context.
items.imageAlt: Merge Mansion and Supercell branding overlay from PocketGamer.biz

items.title: Recent Xbox physical releases appear to ship without security seal stickers
items.summary: Pure Xbox 轉述北美經銷商 VGP 同玩家觀察，多款近期 Xbox 實體版（如 Hellraiser: Revival、Planet Zoo 2、Dragon's Dogma II: Dark Arisen 等）包裝已無傳統防拆 security seal；VGP 稱屬新 packing initiative，Microsoft 未正式說明，亦仍見個別作品保留封條。
items.note: Based on retailer/player observations; no official Microsoft confirmation. Rollout appears inconsistent.
items.imageAlt: Xbox physical game packaging story image from Pure Xbox

items.title: WIRED details Xbox Disc-to-Digital now available to all players
items.summary: WIRED 喺 10 月 19 日詳解 Xbox Disc-to-Digital：Insider 測試後已對全體玩家開放，插入支援嘅 Xbox One／Series 光碟並领取數位授權後可無碟遊玩；授權同光碟綁定、支援遊戲名單未完整公開，賣碟可能令授權轉移。
items.note: Feature explains programme now open beyond Insiders; pairs with ongoing physical-media industry debate.
items.imageAlt: WIRED photo-illustration for Xbox Disc-to-Digital feature

items.title: LOUD win VALORANT Champions 2026, first two-time Champions winners
items.summary: 巴西戰隊 LOUD 喺上海舉行嘅 VALORANT Champions 2026 決賽以 3–1 擊敗 Team Vitality，成為首支兩度奪得 Champions 冠軍嘅隊伍；18 歲指揮 erde 獲賽事 MVP，2027 年 VCT 將轉入更開放賽制。
items.note: Grand final Oct 18; publishedAt assumes Dot Esports 06:14 was EDT.
items.imageAlt: VALORANT Champions 2026 trophy photo coverage
